topology_reasoning.device: unbalanced Mach-Zehnder interferometer built from a left splitter/combiner rectangle, a right splitter/combiner rectangle, and two routed waveguide arms
evidence: The black material is one connected optical circuit with a single horizontal input and output.
Two identical rectangular multimode bodies sit on the input/output axis and launch/recombine two close parallel guides.
The upper and lower arms route away from the coupler axis into large rounded loops before returning to the second rectangle.
The lower arm is visibly longer than the upper arm because it bends farther downward from the off-center coupler axis.
topology_reasoning.working_principle: The first rectangular body splits optical power between two arms. Their unequal optical path lengths accumulate phase difference. The second rectangular body recombines the arms, producing interferometric wavelength-dependent output.
function_defining_knobs: wg_width: single-mode guide width and dominant area/linewidth knob
mmi_length and mmi_width: rectangular splitter/combiner dimensions
split_gap: separation of the two MMI access arms
arm_transition_length: straight/tapered access region between MMI and bends
bend_radius and route_smooth_radius: curvature of the large loop arms
top_y and bottom_y: loop extrema that set footprint and relative path length
delta_length: extra lower-arm horizontal path length; primary interferometer phase/FSR knob

iterations.change_made: Initial smoothed parametric MZI: rectangular MMI splitter/combiner bodies, straight input/output bus, and two gf.Path smooth arms.
Replaced smoothed shoulders with explicit racetrack straight-plus-bend primitive paths; this overflowed height because Euler endpoint semantics expanded the bends.
Switched the racetrack bends from Euler to circular arc primitives, restoring the correct footprint.
Reduced waveguide width to match bus/access strokes and widened the racetrack span.
Replaced ideal racetrack arms with measured x-sampled gf.Path centerlines while keeping MMI rectangles and top-level knobs.
Replaced x-sampled centerlines with skeleton-traced gf.Path centerlines to preserve near-vertical sidewalls; kept the same 0.62 um guide width.

final.note: Stopped after the required maximum of 6 comparison iterations. Best result is below the 0.85 target but is the honest best from the allowed loop.
